sources.name: Fyrirtækjaskrá – Icelandic Company Register (Skatturinn/RSK)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Free open search over the company register, annual-accounts register (ársreikningaskrá) and VAT register in one interface (name/address/kennitala/VSK). No documented public API or bulk download on the page; server-rendered results are scrapeable per-record.

sources.name: Ársreikningaskrá – Annual Accounts Register (via Skatturinn search)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (same portal as fyrirtækjaskrá). Filed annual accounts are retrievable per company through the open search; filings are documents (PDF), record index is parseable. No bulk route found.

sources.name: Central Bank of Iceland – Register of Supervised Entities (eftirlitsskyldir aðilar)
sources.verdict: URL confirmed via sedlabanki.is sitemap. FME merged into the Central Bank in 2020, so this is Iceland's single financial-regulator register (banks, fund management companies/AIFMs, securities firms, insurers, pension funds). Site returns empty content to plain fetchers — JS-rendered; needs headless rendering or manual download.

sources.name: Central Bank of Iceland – Fund Register (skrá yfir sjóði: UCITS & AIFs)
sources.verdict: URL confirmed via sitemap; the dedicated register of Icelandic funds. Page content JS-rendered, empty to plain fetchers.

sources.name: Central Bank of Iceland – Pension Market Supervision
sources.verdict: URL confirmed via sitemap. The Central Bank is Iceland's pension supervisor; section covers licensed pension funds and their reporting. JS-rendered.

sources.name: Central Bank of Iceland – Insurance Supervision (vátryggingastarfsemi)
sources.verdict: URL confirmed via sitemap. Insurance licensees supervised by the Central Bank. JS-rendered.

sources.name: Central Bank of Iceland – Foreign (passporting) Entities Search
sources.verdict: URL confirmed via sitemap — search engine for foreign financial firms passporting into Iceland (EEA). JS-rendered.

sources.name: Central Bank of Iceland – Licences & Registrations index (incl. VASP/crypto registration)
sources.verdict: URL confirmed via sitemap. Central Bank is the competent authority for virtual-asset service provider registration and MiCA in Iceland; no separate standalone VASP list was verifiable this session. JS-rendered.

sources.name: ESMA registers (EEA-wide, includes Icelandic AIFMs/UCITS/firms/MiCA)
sources.verdict: KNOWN-GOOD machine route: ESMA's open registers (searchable + downloadable) cover EEA-EFTA states, giving a structured fallback for Icelandic fund managers/funds/investment firms while the sedlabanki.is site is JS-blocked. Not re-verified this session (search budget exhausted).

sources.name: Lögbirtingablað – Legal Gazette (insolvency & company notices)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Official legal gazette (since 1908); all issues from 1 Jan 2001 online. Contains bankruptcy announcements, estate administration, auctions, court summonses and company/business registration notices. Login only needed for placing ads; reading/search open.

sources.name: Stjórnartíðindi – Official Gazette (laws/regulations)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (stjornartidindi.is now redirects to island.is). Openly searchable A/B/C divisions with category filters, and RSS feeds advertised for all three divisions (feed links on page).

sources.name: Héraðsdómstólar – District Courts (dómasafn ruling search + court schedules)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED to exist (redirects to the island.is district-courts organization page) with 'Dómasafn' ruling search and court-schedule search. Parseability of the search itself unconfirmed. Insolvency case notices flow through Lögbirtingablað, not a standalone insolvency register.

sources.name: Nasdaq Iceland (Kauphöllin) – issuer & market lists
sources.verdict: The old nasdaqomxnordic.com listed-companies page now 301-redirects to nasdaq.com European market activity, which is JavaScript-rendered. Iceland Main Market + First North issuers are there but need headless rendering or Nasdaq data APIs.

sources.name: Nasdaq Nordic/Iceland company disclosures via GlobeNewswire
sources.verdict: GlobeNewswire distributes Nasdaq Iceland company announcements and offers per-search RSS feed generation; exact Iceland-exchange feed URL not pinned down this session (search budget exhausted).

sources.name: Framvís – Association of Venture/Angel Investors, member directory
sources.verdict: VERIFIED with member names: funds (Frumtak, Crowberry Capital, Brunnur Ventures, Reykjavik VC, VEX, Kvika Asset Management, Kría, Alfa Framtak) and angel groups (Tennin, Nordic Ignite, Investa, Silfurberg etc.). Logo-heavy page — names extractable but image-based in places.

sources.name: SFF – Icelandic Financial Services Association (members)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. 24 member firms listed on homepage with links: banks (Arion, Íslandsbanki, Landsbankinn), insurers (Sjóvá, VÍS), fund managers (Íslandssjóðir, Íslensk verðbréf), securities firms. SFF also absorbs the insurance-association role.

sources.name: Landssamtök lífeyrissjóða – Icelandic Pension Funds Association (all funds list)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Structured list of 18 member pension funds with names, descriptions and website links — the core Icelandic LP universe.

sources.name: Viðskiptaráð Íslands – Iceland Chamber of Commerce
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Member directory ('Félagar') plus regular economic research/analysis publications; also runs arbitration services.

sources.name: Business Iceland (Íslandsstofa) – Invest in Iceland
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (businessiceland.is redirects here). Invest-in-Iceland service, export dashboard, sector reports (energy/green, tech, fisheries, tourism, creative).

sources.name: Kría – state venture fund-of-funds (Iceland Venture Initiative)
sources.verdict: Site returns 403 to plain fetchers (bot-blocked) but is the known home of the state VC fund-of-funds that backs Icelandic venture funds. Member list of its portfolio funds partly recoverable via Framvís.

sources.name: Byggðastofnun – Icelandic Regional Development Institute
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. State regional-development lender (general, agricultural, green loans), research fund, regional data dashboards and publications.

sources.name: Útboðsvefur – national public procurement portal
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Shared advertising platform for public tenders (66 live at check), server-rendered searchable table with direct links — parseable without JS. Run under Fjársýslan (which absorbed Ríkiskaup).

sources.name: TED – EU tenders database (covers Iceland via EEA)
sources.verdict: KNOWN-GOOD: above-threshold Icelandic tenders publish to TED, which has a documented open API and bulk downloads. Not re-verified this session.

sources.name: Opnir reikningar – Icelandic state open-payments portal
sources.verdict: Referenced by Fjársýslan's official page as the state open-accounts portal (with rikisreikningur.is and arsreikningar.is for state entities). Not directly fetched this session — access method unconfirmed.

sources.name: International Carbon Registry (ICR) – Iceland-based carbon registry
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Icelandic company (International Carbon Registry ehf.) with a public, browsable project registry (/projects) and carbon directory (developers, VVBs); technical docs at documentation.carbonregistry.com — possible API, unconfirmed.

sources.name: Lögmannafélag Íslands – Bar Association lawyer directory
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Searchable directory of licensed lawyers by firm and specialization (multi-language). Also the practical roll for insolvency trustees (skiptastjórar), who are court-appointed lawyers — Iceland has no separate IP register.

sources.name: FLE – Institute of State Authorized Public Accountants (member directory)
sources.verdict: Association VERIFIED and a 'Félagatal / Members' directory link confirmed in navigation; directory content/parseability not confirmed this session.

sources.name: HMS – Housing and Construction Authority (property register & housing data)
sources.verdict: HMS holds fasteignaskrá (property register, moved from Þjóðskrá) and publishes housing-market data. Site repeatedly returned HTTP 429 to the fetcher during this session — exists but aggressively rate-limited; access method unconfirmed.

sources.name: Statistics Iceland (Hagstofa) – statistical database & open data
sources.verdict: VERIFIED site with statistical database and dedicated open-data access section; the statbank runs PX-Web (px.hagstofa.is) which exposes the standard PX-Web JSON API for enterprise/business statistics.

sources.name: KLAK – Icelandic Startups (ecosystem hub/accelerators)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Runs Gulleggið, Hringiða (green), Startup SuperNova, Startup Tourism etc.; FT-recognized hub — useful for sourcing portfolio companies and venture-studio-adjacent entities.

sources.name: Innherji (Vísir) – financial markets news
sources.verdict: VERIFIED valid RSS 2.0 feed, ~40 items, dedicated markets/finance vertical — the highest-signal free financial feed in Iceland.

sources.name: Vísir – Viðskipti (business news)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED valid RSS 2.0 feed (100+ items, TTL 100 min).

sources.name: mbl.is – Viðskipti (Morgunblaðið business)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via mbl.is official feeds directory, which lists the business feed at /feeds/vidskipti/.

sources.name: Viðskiptablaðið – business weekly
sources.verdict: Iceland's main business paper. Site returned 403 to the fetcher (bot protection); RSS existence unconfirmed. Treat as headless-crawl target; partial paywall.

sources.name: RÚV – national broadcaster news
sources.verdict: VERIFIED valid RSS (general news incl. domestic/economy). A dedicated viðskipti sub-feed was not confirmed — filter by category downstream.

sources.name: Heimildin – investigative/news outlet (successor of Kjarninn + Stundin)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED valid RSS 2.0. Note: the 'Kjarninn' hint is stale — Kjarninn and Stundin merged into Heimildin in 2023.

sources.name: Northstack – Icelandic startup & VC media
sources.verdict: VERIFIED valid RSS (Ghost), active (latest article Apr 2026); covers funding rounds, VC funds, ecosystem data — the best Icelandic venture signal source.

sources.name: Iceland Review – English-language news
sources.verdict: VERIFIED valid RSS 2.0, active (items dated within 2 days of check).

sources.name: The Reykjavík Grapevine – English-language news
sources.verdict: VERIFIED valid RSS 2.0, active.

sources.name: Iceland Monitor – mbl.is English edition
sources.verdict: Site is real and active but its /feeds/ page returned 404 — no working RSS confirmed; crawl or use Icelandic mbl feeds instead.

sources.name: Central Bank of Iceland – news, statistics & press releases
sources.verdict: VERIFIED English site with News and Announcements, statistics (rates, FX), and a 'Subscriptions and RSS' page in the footer (exact feed URL behind that page, not extracted this session).

sources.name: Stjórnarráðið – Government Offices news/press releases
sources.verdict: Key source for ministry decisions (finance, privatization e.g. Íslandsbanki sell-downs). Fetcher received an HTTP 402 anomaly this session — access method unconfirmed; likely crawlable normally.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Icelandic companies, financial statements, ownership/management, market data, legal-gazette monitoring; freemium/subscription. The de-facto local benchmark for entity data UX. Site is a JS SPA (returned only shell to fetchers).

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Credit reports, default registers, company monitoring for Iceland; subscription. Strong on private-debt/NPL-relevant signals (defaults, insolvency).

competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Central Bank supervised-entities & fund registers, pension-fund annual reports (public PDFs on each fund's site), association member lists, press releases.

searchedButAbsent: METHOD CAVEAT: the session's WebSearch budget was already exhausted (200/200) before this task started, so discovery ran entirely on direct URL verification (WebFetch) of known institutions plus the sedlabanki.is sitemap; a broader keyword sweep in Icelandic could not be run. Findings below are what was searched-for/checked and NOT found or not confirmable. (1) No separate private-equity association exists — Framvís (VC/angels) is the only fund-investor association; no BVCA-style PE body found. (2) No standalone insolvency-practitioner roll: trustees (skiptastjórar) are court-appointed lawyers; the only public routes are the Lögmannafélag directory and Lögbirtingablað notices. (3) No dedicated insolvency register: bankruptcy publicity flows through Lögbirtingablað and district courts, not a searchable national insolvency database. (4) No open-data bulk/API route for fyrirtækjaskrá: opingogn.is now redirects to a Digital Iceland page stating the open-data framework is 'being modernized / new arrangement in development' — no dataset catalog or company-register bulk download currently public. (5) FME's standalone site is gone (merged into the Central Bank 2020); all sedlabanki.is register pages exist (sitemap-confirmed) but render empty to non-JS fetchers — headless crawling required. (6) Nasdaq Iceland static issuer lists are gone: nasdaqomxnordic.com redirects to JS-rendered nasdaq.com pages; no parseable public issuer list found. (7) Kjarninn and Fréttablaðið are defunct (Kjarninn+Stundin merged into Heimildin 2023; Fréttablaðið closed 2023) — hint corrected. (8) Nýsköpunarsjóður atvinnulífsins (nsa.is) is unreachable (SSL handshake failure); its reported merger into Kría could not be verified this session. (9) No RICS-style valuer directory found; licensed real-estate agents/appraisers are registered with district commissioners (sýslumenn) but no parseable public roll was verified. (10) No standalone crypto/VASP public list confirmed — registration sits under the Central Bank licensing pages (JS-blocked); ESMA's EEA MiCA register is the machine-readable fallback. (11) No sovereign wealth fund / privatization agency: the proposed Þjóðarsjóður was never established; bank sell-downs run via the Ministry of Finance (Bankasýslan was being wound down). (12) National ETS/carbon account registry (Umhverfisstofnun/Climate authority, EU-registry-based) not verified this session — only the private Iceland-based ICR is cataloged. (13) RSS not confirmed for: Viðskiptablaðið (403 bot-block), Iceland Monitor (/feeds/ 404), Stjórnarráðið (402 anomaly), RÚV business-specific sub-feed. (14) HMS (property register) verified to exist but returned HTTP 429 on every attempt — access method unconfirmed. Iceland is a ~380k-person market: the 42 genuine sources above are materially complete for tiers 1–3; padding to 50 would have required inventing or duplicating.
